extensionDescription.message: Hand the page you are reading to Cognia. Nothing is read until you capture it.

pairIntro.message: Open Cognia on this computer, go to Settings → Connectivity → Pairing → Browser Companion, and generate a pairing code.

pairOriginLabel.message: Before connecting, add this extension origin to Settings → Connectivity → Local host → Browser access

pairWrongFormat.message: That does not look like a Cognia pairing code.

pairVersionMismatch.message: This code is from a newer Cognia. Update the extension.

pairPermissionNeeded.message: Cognia needs permission to reach 127.0.0.1 on this computer.

pairPermissionDenied.message: Without that permission the extension cannot reach Cognia at all.

pairExpired.message: This pairing code has expired. Generate a new one in Cognia.

pairNotLoopback.message: This code is for a different computer. Generate one in Cognia on this computer.

pairMalformed.message: This code is incomplete or damaged. Copy it from Cognia again.

captureEmpty.message: Nothing captured yet. Use the toolbar button, the shortcut, or the right-click menu on a page.

captureRestricted.message: This page cannot be captured. Only ordinary http and https pages can be sent.

captureFullUrlHint.message: Off by default: query strings often carry session tokens and search terms.

instructionPlaceholder.message: What should Cognia do with this?

submitDisabled.message: Cognia has switched off browser submissions. Turn Browser access back on in Settings → Connectivity → Local host.

submitUnknownTarget.message: That destination is no longer available in Cognia. The list has been refreshed — pick one again.

submitUnknownWorkspace.message: That workspace is no longer available in Cognia. The list has been refreshed — pick one again.

submitParamsMissing.message: This template needs every required value filled in.

submitTooLarge.message: This capture is larger than Cognia accepts. Send your selection instead of the whole page.

submitPayloadMismatch.message: This capture changed since the first attempt. Capture the page again and resend.

reasonNoRuntime.message: Waiting for Cognia's runtime — try again once it is running.

reasonRefused.message: Cognia refused this message. Try again, or open the task to see why.

recentEmpty.message: Tasks you start from here will appear in this list.

resultTruncated.message: Shortened — open it in Cognia to read the rest.

stopDrivenElsewhere.message: Cognia is driving this task right now. Stop it there.

stopFailed.message: This task could not be stopped.

hostOffline.message: Cognia is not responding on this computer.

hostOfflineHint.message: Open the app and check Settings → Connectivity → Local host → Browser access.

storageError.message: The extension could not read its local data.

storageErrorHint.message: Try again. If this continues, reload the extension from the browser's extension settings.

revoked.message: This browser is no longer paired with Cognia.

incompatible.message: This extension is too old for the Cognia on this computer.

disconnectConfirmDetail.message: This browser's key is deleted and it will need a new pairing code. Cognia keeps listing it until you revoke it in the device console.

disconnectDoneHint.message: Its key is gone from this browser. To remove it from Cognia as well, revoke it in the device console.

clearLocalConfirmDetail.message: Forgets the cached appearance and the workspace you last chose. You stay paired, and your tasks stay in Cognia.

captureNoGrant.message: Cognia has no access to this tab. Click the toolbar icon on the page you want to send, or use the right-click menu.

notifyNeedsInput.message: A Cognia task needs your input

notifySiteQuestion.message: An agent wants to act on $HOST$. Answer in the Cognia side panel.

agentBarActing.message: Cognia is acting in this tab

agentBarPaused.message: You have control — Cognia is paused

agentModeLabel.message: Let agents act in this browser

agentModeHint.message: Asks Chrome for access to all sites. Cognia still asks you before acting on each site.

agentSitesDenied.message: Chrome did not grant access to sites, so agent mode stays off.

agentPermissionDenied.message: Chrome did not grant that permission.

agentSocketRefused.message: refused — check this browser in Cognia's settings

agentDriveAllowed.message: The Cognia Owner allows agents to act in this browser.

agentDriveNotAllowed.message: Agents cannot act here yet: allow it for this browser in Cognia → Settings → Companion.

agentDownloadsLabel.message: Let agents see and manage downloads

agentCookiesLabel.message: Let agents read and clear cookies

attachRegionHint.message: Drag over the screenshot to choose a region.

attachFailed.message: The screenshot could not be taken.

attachTooLarge.message: That file is larger than Cognia accepts.

attachFullPageCut.message: The page is very long; only its first part was captured.

attachImageUnreadable.message: The image could not be read, so only its address is sent.

attachImageUnsupported.message: That image type cannot be attached; only its address is sent.

attachPdfUnreadable.message: The PDF could not be read.

attachUploadFailed.message: An attachment could not be uploaded: $REASON$

blockedHostsHint.message: Pages on these sites and their subdomains are never read.

blockedHostInvalid.message: That is not a site address.

captureBlocked.message: You have set this site never to be captured.

captureEditText.message: What will be sent (you can trim it)

captureStale.message: This tab has moved on since it was captured.

draftDroppedAttachments.message: Your draft was restored without its $COUNT$ attachments; add them again if you need them.

notificationsHint.message: Shows a system notification while the panel is closed.

pagesFull.message: No more pages fit in one request.

pagesNoTabs.message: No other web tabs are open in this window.

pagesTabsDenied.message: Chrome did not allow listing tabs.

pagesOriginDenied.message: Chrome did not allow reading that site.

pagesReadFailed.message: That tab could not be read.

pagesOverBudget.message: Together these pages are more than Cognia accepts in one request; remove one or trim the text.

promptsEmpty.message: An empty instruction cannot be saved.

promptsTooLong.message: That instruction is too long to save.

promptsFull.message: You have saved as many prompts as fit.

quickPromptSummarize.message: Summarize this page: the main points, then anything I should act on.

quickPromptExplain.message: Explain this clearly, as if to someone new to the subject.

quickPromptTranslate.message: Translate this into my language, keeping the formatting.

recentLoadFailed.message: More tasks could not be loaded.

siteQuestionDetail.message: An agent wants to $ACTION$ on this site.

transcriptFailed.message: The transcript could not be read

agentSocketStatusOnly.message: Connected for status only. Update Cognia and the extension to enable browser actions.

agentSocketIncompatible.message: Protocol incompatible. Update Cognia and the extension, then reconnect.

inspectCommand.message: Pick an element on the page to send to Cognia

inspectPicking.message: Click an element on the page. Shift-click or drag a box to choose several, Alt-click to take all alike, then Enter or Done. ↑ and ↓ move to the parent or child, Esc cancels.

inspectPickHint.message: Cognia: click an element · Shift-click or drag a box to choose several · Alt-click for all alike · Esc cancel

inspectFull.message: That is as many elements as one request takes. Remove one to pick another.

inspectFailed.message: The element could not be picked. Click the extension's icon on the page and try again.

inspectDefaultInstruction.message: Update the source so the picked elements match what I asked for. Use the component names, source positions and selectors to find them.

inspectNoSource.message: No source position: the page does not expose one (production build or unknown framework). The selector still finds it.

inspectNotePlaceholder.message: e.g. make it the primary action, align it with the title

devReportHint.message: Start recording, reproduce the problem, then attach what you did and what the console and requests said. Clicks, keys and navigation are recorded, never what you type. Recording stops if the page reloads; requests that failed since the page loaded are always included.

devReportFailed.message: The console and network could not be read on this page.

devReportEdit.message: Sent with the page — trim anything private

devRecordFailed.message: Recording could not start on this page. Click the extension's icon on the page and try again.

devRecordingLost.message: The page reloaded, which stopped the recording. The report has the failed requests only; start recording again to catch the console.

devDefaultInstruction.message: Find and fix the cause of the errors and failed requests reported for this page.

overlayHint.message: Lay a design export over the page to compare. Take a visible-area screenshot while it is shown to send the comparison.

overlayFailed.message: The design overlay could not be shown on this page.

viewportHint.message: Open the page in a window of that viewport size.

viewportFailed.message: The page could not be opened at that size.

insightFailed.message: This check could not run on the page. Click the extension's icon on the page and try again.

accessHint.message: A first pass with WCAG 2.2 AA thresholds: names, labels, contrast, headings, targets. Not a conformance audit.

accessRuleDuplicateId.message: Id is used more than once

accessRuleHiddenFocus.message: Focusable element hidden from assistive technology

accessRuleTabindex.message: Positive tabindex changes the focus order

tokensHint.message: The colours, type, spacing, radii and variables the page actually uses, most used first. Click a swatch to copy it.

eyedropperRun.message: Pick a colour from the screen

stackHint.message: What the page is built with — frameworks, CMS, styling, build, libraries, analytics and hosting, with versions and how each was found — so the agent starts from the right tools.

stackNone.message: Nothing recognisable: plain HTML, or a build that hides its tooling.

stackDevelopment.message: Development build: component names and source positions are available.

stackProduction.message: Production build: component names and source positions may be missing.

measureWaiting.message: Click the first element, then the one to measure to; Shift-click to keep measuring from the first. Esc cancels.

measureHint.message: Cognia: click the first element to measure from · Esc cancel

measureAnchorHint.message: Cognia: click the element to measure to · Shift-click for more · Esc cancel

measureFailed.message: The page could not be measured. Click the extension's icon on the page and try again.

measureFull.message: That is as many measurements as one request takes. Remove one to measure another.

measureDefaultInstruction.message: Fix the spacing and alignment I measured so it matches my notes. Use the selectors to find the elements.

measureNotePlaceholder.message: e.g. should be 16px, align the left edges

annotateHint.message: Draw on the screenshot. Numbered markers take a note each, sent as text with the image.

annotateFull.message: That is as many marks as one screenshot takes.

annotateFailed.message: The marks could not be drawn onto the screenshot.

inspectCopyCodeHint.message: Copy the element's cleaned HTML and its CSS, with your previewed changes

perfHint.message: How this visit loaded and responded, from the browser's own timeline: Web Vitals, slow scripts, heavy resources, oversized images.

perfNoVitals.message: The browser recorded no Web Vitals for this visit. Reload the page and measure again.

perfOversized.message: Images served much larger than shown: $COUNT$

perfSlowScript.message: Slowest script: $SOURCE$ ($MS$ ms in long frames)

seoHint.message: The title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph and Twitter tags, structured data and heading outline, with a preview of the card a shared link shows.

seoRuleTitleLength.message: The title will be cut off or is too short

seoRuleDescriptionLength.message: The description will be cut off or is too short

seoRuleNoindex.message: Search engines are told not to index this page

seoRuleViewport.message: No viewport tag: phones show the page zoomed out

seoRuleHeadingOne.message: There should be exactly one h1

seoRuleOpenGraph.message: Open Graph tags for link previews are missing

seoRuleOpenGraphImage.message: og:image is not an absolute URL

seoRuleStructuredInvalid.message: Structured data that does not parse

textEditHint.message: Cognia: click any words on the page to change them · finish in the side panel

textEditing.message: Editing the page's text: click any words to change them.

textEditFailed.message: The page's text could not be edited. Click the extension's icon on the page and try again.

textEditDefaultInstruction.message: Update the copy in the source to match my text changes. Use the selectors to find each one.

inspectContrastFixHint.message: Preview the nearest colour that passes WCAG AA on this background

layoutHint.message: What makes the page scroll sideways, text cut off by its box, stretched images and text too small to read, at this window size.

layoutRuleOverflow.message: Wider than the window: the page scrolls sideways

layoutRuleClipped.message: Text cut off by its box

layoutScrolls.message: The page is $PAGE$px wide in a $VIEWPORT$px window, so it scrolls sideways.

adjustButtonHint.message: Resize it by dragging its edges and nudge its spacing with the arrow keys, on the page itself

adjustHint.message: Drag the right or bottom edge to resize. Arrows add margin, Alt+arrow takes it away, Shift for 10px, P switches to padding. Enter keeps it, Esc undoes it.

adjustFailed.message: Couldn't adjust the element on this page.

mockHint.message: Make the page's own requests fail, answer, change, wait or go elsewhere, to see how it copes. Rules last until the page reloads unless kept, and what you send says which requests were simulated.

mockLost.message: The page reloaded, so these rules no longer apply.

mockFailed.message: Couldn't change the requests on this page.

compareHint.message: Measure how far the page is from the mock: the overlay is hidden for a moment, the visible page captured, and the two compared pixel by pixel

compareOutOfView.message: The mock isn't in view. Scroll to it or move it, then compare again.

compareFailed.message: Couldn't compare the page with the mock.

compareDefaultInstruction.message: Make the page match the design mock where they differ.

focusHint.message: The order Tab moves through the page, numbered on it, and where it goes wrong: positive tabindex, hidden stops, focus jumping back up, and clickable things the keyboard can't reach.

focusRuleHidden.message: Tab stops on something that can't be seen

focusRuleJump.message: Focus jumps back up the page

focusRuleUnreachable.message: Looks clickable, but the keyboard can't reach it

toolbarToggleHint.message: Float pick, measure, adjust, text editing and screenshots on the page itself

toolbarFailed.message: Couldn't show the toolbar on this page.

panelTagline.message: Capture, inspect and hand pages to Cognia

captureSubtitle.message: Start from the page in front of you

inspectSectionSubtitle.message: Point at the page to pick, measure and change it

inspectTilePickHint.message: Pick an element on the page to describe it to Cognia

inspectTileMeasureHint.message: Measure the distance between two elements

inspectTileTextHint.message: Change the page's words in place

pageToolsSubtitle.message: Console, design overlay, screen sizes, mocks

toolbarSnapHint.message: Let go of the toolbar and it moves to the nearer side; along the top or bottom, to a side or the middle

inspectPickSelected.message: Cognia: $COUNT$ chosen · Shift-click to add or remove · Enter or Done to add them · Esc cancel

compareAllSame.message: They share every reported style ($COUNT$ properties).

compareInclude.message: Send the comparison with the task

mockRuleFailAfter.message: Fails with a network error after $MS$ ms

mockBodyMerge.message: Merge into the body (JSON fields, or text to append)

mockTargetHint.message: A full URL, or what replaces the matched part. With a /regex/ match, $$1 and $$2 take its groups.

mockHeaders.message: Response headers (one name: value per line)

mockLimitsHint.message: Limit a rule to its first few matches, or let it strike at random to find flaky handling.

mockMatchHint.message: Part of the URL; * matches anything, /…/ is a regular expression.

mockKeepHint.message: Rules come back before the page's scripts run, in this tab, until cleared. Asks for access to this site.

mockKeepDenied.message: Without access to this site, the rules end when the page reloads.

mockLogEmpty.message: Nothing caught yet — use the page and they appear here.
